reproduction_manifest.notes: Successfully reproduced the Transferability Difference metric for GCN size transfer on Cora (2-layer, 32-hidden, Scheme I sparsity f(n)=2.0/n). The reproduced value 0.3488 at n=600 is lower (better) than the paper's visually-estimated ~0.40 from Figure 5(b). The difference is attributed to: (1) different PyTorch/torch-geometric versions (2.1.0/2.8.0 vs paper's 2.6.0/2.6.1), (2) different random initialization (paper did not specify seeds), (3) the paper's metric was visually estimated from a plot rather than numerically reported. Fixed seeds (42) ensure deterministic reproduction. The code runs correctly and produces the full transfer error curve across all 3 sparsity schemes and 11 graph sizes (100-600).
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse stdout for 'Scheme 1] Sample size 600: mean_diff = X.XXXX' or read CSV column 'mean_diff' for scheme_id=1, sample_size=600 in {dataset}_Test_{layers}_{hidden}.csv. The Transferability Difference is the mean L2 node-wise discrepancy between subgraph GCN output and full-graph reference output.
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: 1. Architecture: num_layers (2|3), hidden_channels (32|64|128|256). 2. Training: epochs (200 default), learning_rate (0.08 default), graph_size for training (500 default), weight_decay (5e-4 default). 3. Aggregation: SpecificAggrLayer normalization uses 1/sqrt(2|E|) factor which could be tuned. 4. Sampling: num_trials (20 default), sample_sizes range (100-600 for Cora). 5. The training uses a random 500-node subgraph with 50/50 train/test split for supervised classification; different training strategies could be explored.
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Installed torch-geometric 2.8.0, ogb 1.3.6, pandas 2.3.3, scikit-learn 1.7.2 via pip with Tsinghua mirror. Container uses PyTorch 2.1.0 with CUDA 12.1 (paper recommends 2.6.0 but code is compatible). Added torch.manual_seed(42), np.random.seed(42), random.seed(42) with cudnn deterministic flags to both Stretched_GCN_train.py and Stretched_GCN_test.py for reproducible training/evaluation. Created /repo/run_transfer_error.sh wrapper script that chains training and testing. Cora dataset auto-downloaded by torch_geometric to data/Planetoid/. Model saved as Cora_model_2_32.pt, results as Cora_Test_2_32.csv in the Transfer Error directory.

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize Transferability Difference (L2 discrepancy) for Scheme I sparsity at n=600 on Cora with 2-layer 32-hidden GCN. Lower transfer error means better size transferability across sparsity levels.

metrics.name: Transferability Difference (Scheme I, n=600)
metrics.rationale: This is the paper's primary theoretical claim: GCN transfer error vanishes as graph size increases and edge density decreases. Scheme I (f(n)=2.0/n) represents the most extreme sparsity not covered by prior theoretical guarantees. Lower values validate the generalized graphon framework.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Primary goal: reduce Transferability Difference at n=600 below 0.3488. Any reduction in the core metric is a win, provided the full transfer error curve (100-600) remains monotonically decreasing with graph size (preserving the theoretical trend). Guardrail: other sparsity schemes (II, III) and graph sizes should not regress substantially.
